name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Nigeria to free Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, a singer sentenced to death for song lyrics about the Prophet Muhammad. He was tried without a lawyer, and his appeal to Nigeria's Supreme Court is still pending. The Parliament says his health is failing in prison. It also asks Nigeria to drop all blasphemy charges, stop executions, and protect freedom of religion and speech. This is an opinion; the Parliament cannot change Nigerian law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks Nigeria to release Sharif-Aminu and drop blasphemy charges.
- **Who it affects:** Sharif-Aminu, other people held on blasphemy charges, and religious minorities in Nigeria.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends this request to the European Union bodies and to Nigeria's government and parliament.
